adaptation.rule: Adapt question concepts and pass criteria only; use the independently verified public snapshot, not internal data or answers.

scope.survey: audited NEFSC bottom-trawl records in the pinned public extract
limitations: The public extract is a selected snapshot, not a complete survey species catalog.
The source metadata does not specify EXPCATCHWT units.
Station records are not necessarily valid tows or standardized effort.
Catch totals do not establish population abundance, biomass, recruitment, fishing mortality, or stock status.

splits.holdout_note: Frozen for the next agent-evaluation iteration; this is a prospective holdout, not a blind set, because its cases and criteria are checked into the repository.

evaluation_layers.scripted_stdio: Direct MCP calls, output-schema validation, and independent raw-CSV/Decimal reconciliation; does not score LLM behavior.
evaluation_layers.agent_quality: A supplied 33-trial repeat set covers NOAA A01/B01/C01 and Q01/Q02/Q03/Q05/Q07/Q08/Q09/Q10. All 76 successful tool payloads matched the pinned raw-CSV reference; answer-level review identifies repeated tool and interpretation weaknesses. Every trial remains UNVERIFIED; run configuration and evaluated database identity are unavailable. No independent scientific review or overall agent pass is claimed; see submission/public-evaluation-appendix.md and eval/published_reference/repeated-trials-review.md. Historical agent_evaluation fields below describe scripted artifacts, not these later agent trials.
evaluation_layers.hill_climb: Change one documented tool-schema, description, or prompt factor at a time; compare fixed development questions to the preserved baseline; use the frozen holdout only for confirmation. Report negative results and repeat agent trials.

candidate.change: Tightened MCP schemas/descriptions to match the fixed 2021-2025 snapshot and exactly two comparable species; added supported/unsupported analysis declarations to the resource.
candidate.interpretation: All direct MCP/data-contract checks pass before and after. This is not evidence of improved agent selection, prose, or scientific reasoning.

latency_note: Baseline and candidate round-trip measurements are descriptive only; no latency improvement is claimed from these small runs.
